address_note: gov.uk's centre finder could not be opened from this machine (find-driving-test-centre service did not answer; gov.uk site search does not list centre pages). Address taken from DVSA's own bulletin of 2 Dec 2016 (new centre on Selby Road from 9 Jan 2017, first said to be temporary) and matched by a page quoting DVSA's find-a-centre data captured 2026-05-12 (passrates.uk) and by 2023-24 pass-rate listings; pass 1 records 12,178 tests in 2024-25, so the centre is open at this address. OSM places Selby Road way/5739684 about 100 m from the given position, so it matches. Recheck on gov.uk find-driving-test-centre when reachable.

places.name: Selby Road
places.note: The centre's own road, so every test leaves and returns by it; known from the address, not from route sources.

places.name: Great Cambridge Road (A10)
places.note: Dual carriageway about 500 m west of the centre; named as likely by s1's editorial text, and implied by s2 and s3 (the roundabout is on it).

places.name: North Circular Road (A406)
places.note: s1 is editorial, not first-hand, so only s2 counts as first-hand: likely.

places.name: Great Cambridge roundabout (A10 / A406)
places.note: Large multi-lane roundabout with lane markings by destination, about 1.1 km north of the centre; two separate learners' own test accounts name it.

summary: 1 confirmed junction (the Great Cambridge roundabout, A10/A406, from two separate learners' own test accounts) and 3 likely roads (Selby Road, Great Cambridge Road A10, North Circular A406); no free source gives turn-by-turn roads, so the residential streets round the Selby Centre rest on the map and judgement. Two routes meeting the overlap rule look possible from the map (quiet streets both sides of the A10, the A10 and A406 dual carriageways, the roundabout), but the evidence supports only the roundabout and the two main roads.
